UserAccount.title: User Account & Workspace Profile
UserAccount.description: Synchronized personal owner account, recovery email, and workspace preferences across Android and Web.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

username.description: Display username of the chart workspace owner (1 to 60 characters).

email.description: Owner email address for Google Sign-In and password recovery (3 to 120 characters).

isDarkTheme.description: Whether dark financial theme is active.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated per-user account profile and workspace preferences.
